description:
Correct two state/interaction defects:
- `components/WorkspaceLane.js:409-437`: remove the `{ once: true }` keydown behavior that drops Enter/Escape after the first typed character. Use one cleanup path across Enter, Escape, and blur; Escape must restore the original title.
- `components/ContextMenu.js:67-88`: after successful "Move to new group", call `unassignTab(tab.id)` before dispatching the rename event, matching the existing-group path.

Acceptance criteria:
- Rename supports arbitrary typing followed by Enter, Escape, or blur without duplicate commits.
- Escape restores the pre-edit title.
- Moving to a new native group removes the old Meridian assignment and does not resurrect it after ungrouping.
- Focused regression coverage is added.
label: Bug
title: Fix lane rename keyboard handling and native group assignment cleanup

activity.content:
## Completed

- Reworked lane rename handling so ordinary keystrokes no longer remove the Enter/Escape listener.
- Unified Enter, Escape, and blur finalization with listener cleanup, single-commit behavior, and exact original-title restoration on Escape.
- Cleared the old Meridian workspace assignment after a native group is created and before the lane rename event is dispatched.
- Added focused regressions covering Enter after typing, Escape restoration, blur deduplication, and native-group assignment cleanup/order.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/laneRenameAndContextMenu.test.mjs` - 4 passed.
- `node --test` - 27 passed.
- `node --check components/WorkspaceLane.js` and `node --check components/ContextMenu.js` - passed.
- `git diff --check` - passed.
Reviewer approved: implementation/output verified against the task scope; combined suite passes (41/41) and shipped source/package parity passes.
